entities.summary: Founded in 1675 by Charles II to solve the problem of determining longitude at sea. Greenwich Observatory's precise astronomical observations, development of marine chronometers, and establishment of the Prime Meridian (0 degrees longitude) made it the reference point for global timekeeping and navigation.
